objective: Test whether YADO can use independent external problem specifications to select and materialize a changed Python source candidate, freeze its identity, and improve on sealed external cases without using sealed expected values for mutation selection.

admission.reason: The first run is an evidence-producing shadow experiment. Passing it does not by itself make the synthesized solver a canonical cognitive mechanism.

claim_boundary.interpretation: A PASS demonstrates bounded source-level adaptation on independent external cases under a predefined synthesis grammar, not unrestricted autonomous software evolution.
